headings.instruction: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all major headings. Never use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans for H1/H2. This gives the athletic, punchy feel.

body.instruction: Use Manrope for body text, numerical data, time slots, and pricing. It provides exceptional numerical legibility which is crucial for pricing and scheduling.

colors.instructions: Avoid teal green (#1B93A4). Use pure white for booking cards/widgets for maximum contrast against the soft off-white background. The primary green (#059669) must be used strictly for active booking states and primary CTAs.

surfaces.customer_marketplace: Flat surfaces with 1px delicate borders (border-border), no massive drop shadows. Keep it tactile and 'Neumorphic' crisp.
surfaces.owner_admin_dashboard: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton, dense compact spacing, 1px borders.
surfaces.navigation: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a 1px border-b.

visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for sections. Sticky booking widget on desktop, bottom fixed CTA on mobile.
visual_enhancers.trust_signals: Visual indicators (badges, icons) for Escrow, Instant Confirmation, and Refund Policies. Must be highly visible, not hidden.

layouts_and_grids.marketplace_home: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for featured turfs and categories. Asymmetrical, visually engaging.
layouts_and_grids.turf_profile: Bento Grid protocol. Left side (col-span-8) for photo gallery, amenities, and explicit rules. Right side (col-span-4) sticky booking widget.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized, no jagged bottoms. Sharp edges or max 8px radius.

components.booking_calendar: Custom dense UI using Shadcn Calendar logic. Show ONLY available slots natively. Block out double-booked slots. Instant click-to-select without page reloads.
components.forms_and_checkout: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Select. Guest checkout requires minimal fields (Name, Phone/Email).
components.cancellation_timer: Sticky or prominently placed visual countdown timer for the full-refund window (e.g., '23h 59m remaining for 100% refund').
components.data_display: Shadcn Table for Admin/Owner booking history, payouts, and dispute management.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis for smooth scrolling on marketing/discovery pages.
motion_and_interactions.slot_selection: Micro-animations on time slots (scale down slightly on press, snap to active color).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion for route transitions to ensure 'liquid' feel.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast on active focus rings (focus:ring-primary).

hero_backgrounds.description: Accra urban architecture background for context

turf_placeholders.description: Aerial view of a soccer team on a green field

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all interactive elements (buttons, slots, forms).
Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids for discovery and strict dense grids for dashboards.
Implement explicit trust messaging (escrow, refund policies) with high contrast.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons exclusively.
Ensure the booking widget is sticky on desktop and fixed to the bottom on mobile.
Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for any sticky headers or dropdowns.
Avoid the 'AI slop' look: avoid large drop shadows, avoid universal transitions, do not center text paragraphs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic: no simplistic gradients or uniform boring styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
